thread:
maria: NorthStar Partners (AWS reseller) just raised an urgent billing dispute. They say they were billed twice for Feb usage of our embeddings SKU due to a pricing experiment we ran (A/B pricing). They attached both invoices and settlement CSVs. Can someone triage? :grimacing:
ashok: Oof. Please paste the invoice lines + partner settlement rows.
maria: Invoice A (our hosted invoice to customer):
```
INV-2026-02-4010
SKU: redwood_embeddings_e1
Qty: 10,000 units
Unit price (A): $0.0008
Line net: $8.00
```
Invoice B (experiment variant billed via marketplace adapter):
```
INV-2026-02-4011
SKU: redwood_embeddings_e1_expt
Qty: 10,000 units
Unit price (B): $0.0006
Line net: $6.00
```
Partner settlement CSV rows from NorthStar (as received from AWS):
```
sku,units,unit_settled,platform_fee
redwood_embeddings_e1,10000,0.0008,0.80
redwood_embeddings_e1_expt,10000,0.0006,0.60
```
northstar_support: They say AWS Marketplace created two metering rows for the same underlying usage because our experiment name (redwood_embeddings_e1_expt) was still active in the marketplace adapter for a subset of events. So AWS settled both rows and they were charged/credited twice. They are asking us to reconcile and credit the reseller for the over-collection.
james: billing-bot, show which pricing profile and exporter version drove the marketplace feed for merchant=northstar on 2026-02-28.
billing-bot: export job complete for merchant=northstar at 2026-02-28T23:57Z. Exporter version: marketplace-connector@v2.14. Pricing profiles referenced in export: PROFILE_PUBLIC_A/BETA_EXPT. Experiment flag: embeddings_expt=true.
ashok: So the connector included both canonical SKU and experiment alias. That double-counted meter rows. That's on our side. Sophie, did we toggle the experiment flag in prod in Feb?
sophie: We ran a limited pricing experiment for embeddings between Feb 20-25 to test a lower trial price for new signups. The adapter had a conditional that injects the _expt alias for eligible accounts. Looks like a bug: the adapter should have deduped by canonical usage ID but didn't. I opened an engineering ticket ENG-PR-2921.
maria: Finance needs the dollar over-collection to issue a credit memo. Partner says net overcharge = $8.00 (they were billed $14 total but should only be billed $6 under the experiment or vice versa depending on contract). Can someone compute the delta and provide files?
ames: (typo) james: Quick math from CSV: total billed = 10000*(0.0008+0.0006)=14.00; expected single row at agreed price (we need to know which price applies). Contractually for reseller-sourced customers, the committed marketplace price was $0.0006 (experiment variant authorized for pilot). So partner should have been charged $6.00 -> overcharge = $8.00. Reconciliation file uploaded: s3://redwood-billing/aws/recons/2026-02/northstar-double-bill-1799807777.csv
aws-partner-bot: AWS ticket created: AWS-17345. Partner escalated to AWS marketplace billing team requesting reversal of duplicate settlement. AWS responded they can only reverse if metering rows are retracted before settlement cutoff; otherwise reseller needs to request adjustment via us.
nashok: So we need to issue a credit memo CM-2026-02-011 for $8.00 to NorthStar. AP approval required. Also engineering fix + hotfix to exporter to dedupe by canonical usage-id. James, can you lead the PR and a hotfix rollback if needed?
james: I'll patch marketplace-connector to dedupe on usage_id and add a regression test. I'll cut v2.14.1 hotfix and deploy to exporter fleet. ETA 4 hours for rollout. Will link PR in thread.
maria: Kelly/AP - please advise on issuing credit memo for $8.00. Supporting docs: INV-2026-02-4010, INV-2026-02-4011, reconciliation file, ENG ticket ENG-PR-2921, AWS ticket AWS-17345.
kelly: AP here. For marketplace double-bill credits under $500 we can approve provisional credits with engineering and partner confirmation. I need the computed delta, reconciliation export link, and partner escalation email.
maria: Files: s3://redwood-billing/aws/recons/2026-02/northstar-double-bill-1799807777.csv, internal export https://internal.redwood/billing/exports/1799807777 (md5:d41d8cd98f00b204e9800998ecf8427e). Partner email thread attached.
kelly: Approved provisional credit CM-2026-02-011 for $8.00 to NorthStar. Will post in 2 business days and mark as provisional pending AWS confirmation.
sophie: I'll keep the partner posted and ask AWS to look at metering retraction options, but we shouldn't rely on AWS to reverse.
ajames: PR link: https://git.internal/redwood/marketplace-connector/pull/412 (hotfix v2.14.1). Pushed dedupe check and integration test. Rolling out now.
nashok: After rollout, let's scan exporter logs for duplicate usage double-hits between Feb 20-25 and collect any other affected merchants. If duplicates > $1000 total we need exec notification. James, add a reconciliation job to run across last 30 days.
james: Will run full scan and post results in this thread. Preliminary scan: only 3 merchants affected, total provisional liability ~ $28.00.
maria: Great. Posting CM once kelly confirms posting. Leaving thread open until CM posted and hotfix rolled. :thumbsup:
